title: Thomas Bearden and Soviet scalar death ray

tellings.quote: Thomas Bearden was this Navy guy who constantly yeah talked about sort of scalar weaponry. He said that the Soviets sort of figured out this massive death ray sort of thing.

plain: The claim is that the Soviet Union worked out a huge "death ray", a so-called scalar weapon, meaning an exotic kind of energy weapon. Michels tells it himself, while talking with a man named Matthew Brown whom the episode presents as a Pentagon whistleblower. Michels says the idea comes from Thomas Bearden, "this Navy guy" who kept talking about scalar weaponry. If it were true, a rival power would have held a weapon far beyond anything publicly known.
